metadata.description: A curated collection of plugins for Claude Code and Tanzu Platform

plugins.name: mailgun
plugins.description: Send emails via Mailgun API. Use when the user requests to send an email, notify someone via email, or compose and deliver email messages to recipients.

plugins.name: google-chat-poster
plugins.description: Post messages to Google Chat Spaces using the Google Chat API. Use when the user requests to send, post, or publish messages to Google Chat.

plugins.name: cf-space-auditor
plugins.description: Audit Cloud Foundry spaces for compliance with memory allocation standards, instance counts, and deployment staleness. Use when the user asks to audit a CF space or check space compliance.

plugins.name: application-advisor
plugins.description: Automate Spring dependency upgrades using Broadcom Application Advisor. Use when the user asks about Spring upgrades, Application Advisor, the advisor CLI, Broadcom registry tokens, or automated dependency management for Spring projects.

plugins.name: agent-buildpack
plugins.description: Build and deploy AI agent demos on Tanzu Platform for Cloud Foundry using the Agent Buildpack and MCP Gateway. Bundles three skills: deploying agents and MCP Gateway wiring, scaffolding Spring AI MCP servers, and native agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
